analysis: Examined base_text units for docs/architecture/inference.md lines 1638-2205 (MiMo V2.6 native candidate, Flash-Next, coordinator channels, invariants, code map, Flint, Bonsai, GLM). These lines are unchanged context; the only change (head 595-611, per the complete range map) is documentation of a Gated DeltaNet prefill kernel auto-selection for qwen3_5/qwen3_5_moe/prism_hadamard_qwen35. The selection uses a bit-exact GPU probe against gated_delta_step, otherwise falls back to the stock kernel, and keeps decode/MTP/masked paths on the stock kernel. DARKBLOOM_TTFT_GDN_BLOCKED is an operator-controlled A/B override. Relevant threats: T-041 (prefix-cache checkpoint integrity, which the doc claims is unaffected because recurrent state is bit-identical), T-007/T-027 (output correctness), and TB-003 (operator env controls are already in operator scope). No change to cache salt scoping, at-rest crypto, attestation or authorization. The per-process probe could add a small TTFT difference on the first window, but it is per-process, not per-tenant prompt content, so it adds no new cross-tenant oracle beyond SEC-035. A forced env override is operator-controlled and does not cross a trust boundary. No regression was identified. The integration pass should confirm that GatedDelta.swift (not supplied) falls back safely when the probe fails and that forced kernels cannot corrupt shared SSD checkpoints. Today that would at most cause recompute or wrong output under operator control.
